summary: Completed comprehensive testing of iteration 3 features: 22 dynamic service area detail pages, Gallery page, 4 new homepage text sections, and updated navigation/footer. All features working correctly.

Gallery page shows stats section (5,000+ Homes Serviced, 20+ Years, etc.)
Gallery page has CTA section with quote and call buttons
Service area detail page /service-areas/st-johns-fl loads with custom intro, services grid, FAQ, contact form
Service area detail page /service-areas/atlantic-beach-fl loads with custom coastal content
Service area detail page /service-areas/orange-park-fl loads with generated content
Service area detail page /service-areas/mandarin-jacksonville loads correctly
Unknown service area slug /service-areas/unknown-area-xyz redirects to /service-areas
Header nav shows 'Gallery' link that navigates to /gallery
Footer shows all 22 service area links with correct hrefs
Footer quick links include Gallery
Homepage 'Jacksonville's FL Trusted Gutter Cleaning Services' section visible (data-testid: jax-trusted-section)
Homepage 'About Gutters Cleaning Jacksonville, FL' section visible (data-testid: about-gutters-jax-section)
Homepage 'When Should You Clean Your Gutters?' section visible (data-testid: when-to-clean-section)
Homepage 'Why Choose Jacksonville Gutter Company?' section visible (data-testid: why-choose-jax-section)
Homepage internal links to service areas (St Johns, Atlantic Beach, etc.) work
Homepage internal links to Gallery work
Homepage internal links to Cost Guide work
Contact form on service area detail page submits successfully (POST /api/leads)
Contact form shows 'Thank You' success message after submission
Service area pages have internal cross-links to services, gallery, cost guide, about
Service area pages show links to other nearby service areas
Backend API /api/ root endpoint working
Backend API POST /api/leads creates leads correctly
Backend API admin login with correct password (gutterjax2024) works
Backend API admin login rejects invalid passwords
Backend API GET /api/admin/leads returns leads list
Backend API GET /api/admin/stats returns stats
